title: Namaz of Imam Hasan Askari (a)
introduction:
NAMAZ OF IMAM AL-HASAN AL-ASKARI (A.S.)

A four-unit prayer transmitted from the Eleventh Imam, al-Hasan al-Askari (a.s.).

verses.translation: This prayer consists of four units (first two with Surah al-Zalzalah 15 times, second two with Surah al-Tawheed 15 times). After the prayer, recite the dua of Imam Askari (a.s.):
